cfg.textstudio.chat.chat.description: Server-authoritative chat length, history storage, and signature rules. Both singleplayer and multiplayer save through the active server; editing requires permission level 2.
cfg.textstudio.chat.chat.compact_chat.de: Merges consecutive identical messages and appends a count, reducing spam from system messages, mod errors, or repeated player messages.
cfg.textstudio.chat.chat.draggable_scrol: Shows a draggable scrollbar on the right side of chat for quickly browsing a large message history.
cfg.textstudio.chat.chat.heads.desc: Renders real-time skin avatars before chat messages. Prioritizes premium skins with automatic offline-skin fallback based on UUID.
cfg.textstudio.chat.chat.history_lines.d: Maximum history lines retained by the server for each player and synchronized to clients as the display limit. Valid range is 100–100000; server storage also has a per-player size budget.
Controls whether the server persists player chat and input history across sessions. When disabled, no new persistent history is recorded or synchronized; existing saved history is not deleted automatically.
cfg.textstudio.chat.chat.max_length.desc: Maximum characters accepted by the chat box, packets, and commands. Vanilla uses 256; clients and servers should use matching values.
cfg.textstudio.chat.chat.strip_signature: Controls whether the server strips chat signatures before broadcasting and synchronizes that choice to clients for the matching report and insecure-chat UI behavior.
cfg.textstudio.chat.chat.timestamp.desc: Shows a local timestamp with millisecond precision [HH:mm:ss.SSS] before every chat message.
gui.textstudio.chat.chat.back.desc: Exit capture mode and return to chat screen.
gui.textstudio.chat.open_canvas.desc: Open virtual canvas for scrolling, selecting, and copying full chat history.
gui.textstudio.chat.module.name: Chat Presentation
gui.textstudio.chat.module.tooltip: Provides chat display, copying, history, and related chat enhancements.
cfg.textstudio.chat.client.description: Affects only this client's display and interaction preferences. These settings are stored locally and never written to the server config.

cmd.textstudio.font.effect.filtered: §ePreset ID %s applied; §anon-authors keep only basic gradient/palette color effects and advanced effects were stripped
cmd.textstudio.font.effect.fail.author_o: §cThis effect is restricted to hardcoded author accounts
cmd.textstudio.font.style.fail.author_on: §cAdvanced name effects such as jitter and glitch are restricted to hardcoded author accounts
gui.textstudio.font.editor.tip.category_: §eClick to expand the effect category list. §bUse the mouse wheel or drag the scrollbar; every entry is a real button.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.use_rainbow.t: §fContinuously cycles hue across the text to create a flowing rainbow.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.rainbow_speed: §fControls how quickly the rainbow hue moves over time; higher values change colors faster.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.rainbow_sprea: §fControls hue spacing between adjacent glyphs; higher values show a wider color spread at once.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.pulse.tip: §fPeriodically raises and lowers text brightness for a smooth breathing-light effect.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.pulse_base.ti: §fSets the baseline brightness of the breathing effect; higher values keep the dim phase brighter.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.pulse_amp.tip: §fControls the brightness swing of the breathing effect; higher values create stronger contrast.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.pulse_speed.t: §fControls how quickly one breathing cycle repeats.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.fade.tip: §fPeriodically lowers and restores text opacity to create a fading flicker.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.fade_min.tip: §fSets the minimum opacity reached during a fade; lower values approach full disappearance.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.fade_speed.ti: §fControls how quickly the fade and recovery cycle repeats.
§fSimulates an unstable neon tube with irregular short brightness drops.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.neon_flicker_: §fControls how frequently the neon short-circuit state refreshes.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.chromatic.tip: §fDraws red/cyan offset layers around the text for a cyber or 3D chromatic-aberration look.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.chromatic_off: §fControls the distance between the red/cyan layers and the main glyph.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.chromatic_alp: §fControls the visibility of the red/cyan chromatic layers.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.chromatic_pul: §fMakes chromatic offset distance breathe over time instead of staying fixed.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.shimmer.tip: §fMoves a bright highlight band across the text, resembling polished metal or flowing energy.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.shimmer_speed: §fControls how quickly the highlight band travels across the text.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.shimmer_width: §fControls how many glyphs the highlight band covers at once.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.shimmer_stren: §fControls how strongly the highlight band boosts the original text brightness.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.sparkle.tip: §fRandomly gives some glyphs short bright flashes for a stardust effect.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.sparkle_speed: §fControls how quickly sparkle positions are randomized again.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.sparkle_chanc: §fControls the proportion of glyphs sparkling at once; higher values are denser.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.sparkle_stren: §fControls the brightness boost applied to sparkling glyphs.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.wave.tip: §fMoves glyphs smoothly up and down to form a continuous wave.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.wave_amp.tip: §fControls the vertical height of the wave motion.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.wave_speed.ti: §fControls how quickly wave peaks travel and repeat across the text.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.bounce.tip: §fMakes glyphs jump upward and fall back rhythmically.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.bounce_amp.ti: §fControls the maximum height of each bounce.
§fControls how quickly the bounce animation repeats.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.shake.tip: §fApplies small rapid random movement, useful for tension, impact, or malfunction effects.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.shake_amp.tip: §fControls the maximum distance of random shaking.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.shake_speed.t: §fControls how often shake positions refresh; higher values feel more frantic.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.swing.tip: §fMoves glyphs left and right on a smooth curve instead of random jitter.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.swing_speed.t: §fControls how quickly the swing cycle repeats.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.wiggle.tip: §fGives each glyph a different irregular phase for a lively or unstable motion.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.wiggle_amp.ti: §fControls how far glyphs can move away from their original positions.
§fControls how quickly the wiggle pattern changes.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.turb.tip: §fCombines several smooth disturbances so text continuously drifts like liquid turbulence.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.turb_amp.tip: §fControls the overall positional strength of the turbulence.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.turb_speed.ti: §fControls how quickly the turbulence pattern evolves.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.pend.tip: §fMoves glyphs back and forth with a regular pendulum-like rhythm and inertia.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.pend_speed.ti: §fControls the speed of each back-and-forth pendulum cycle.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.orbit.tip: §fMoves glyphs around their original positions on small circular paths.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.orbit_amp.tip: §fControls the radius of the circular path.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.orbit_speed.t: §fControls how quickly glyphs travel around their orbit.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.ripple.tip: §fPropagates displacement through later glyphs like a traveling ripple.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.ripple_amp.ti: §fControls the maximum displacement produced by the ripple.
§fControls how quickly the ripple travels across the text.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.drift.tip: §fSlowly floats glyphs around their original positions, suited to dreamlike, magical, or ghostly text.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.drift_amp.tip: §fControls the maximum range of the floating motion.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.drift_speed.t: §fControls how quickly the drifting path changes.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.glitch.tip: §fCreates large cyber-style tearing, displacement, and momentary visual errors.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.glitch_amp.ti: §fControls the maximum displacement caused by a glitch tear.
§fControls how often a new glitch state is generated.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.glitch_flicke: §fControls the chance for glyphs to disappear during a glitch; higher values look more fragmented.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.spasm.tip: §fMakes individual glyphs jump horizontally at high frequency for an aggressive electronic glitch.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.spasm_speed.t: §fControls how frequently each glyph chooses a new jump position.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.typewriter.ti: §fReveals text one glyph at a time like a terminal or story typewriter.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.typewriter_sp: §fControls how quickly new glyphs are revealed.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.typewriter_ba: §fWhen enabled, completed text is erased one glyph at a time in reverse before restarting.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.blink_wave.ti: §fPropagates a brightness pulse through glyphs one by one.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.blink_wave_sp: §fControls how quickly the brightness pulse travels across the text.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.blink_wave_de: §fSets how dim a glyph becomes when the pulse passes; lower values create stronger contrast.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.glyph_scale.t: §fPeriodically scales each glyph around its own center.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.glyph_scale_a: §fControls how much each glyph changes size.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.glyph_scale_s: §fControls how quickly glyphs grow and shrink.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.ecg.tip: §fSends a sharp displacement spike across the text like an ECG pulse.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.ecg_amp.tip: §fControls how high the ECG spike lifts affected glyphs.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.ecg_speed.tip: §fControls how quickly the ECG spike scans from start to end.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.ecg_width.tip: §fControls how many neighboring glyphs are affected by one ECG spike.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.heartbeat.tip: §fCreates fast, sharp heartbeat-like jumps rather than a smooth normal bounce.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.heartbeat_amp: §fControls the height of the heartbeat pulse.
§fOccasionally throws one glyph far out of place and immediately restores it, simulating a signal spike.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.glitch_spike_: §fControls the maximum displacement of a glitch spike.
§fControls how quickly new glitch-spike checks are made.
§fControls the chance that each check produces a spike.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.signal_loss.t: §fRandomly hides a few glyphs for an instant to simulate digital signal loss.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.signal_loss_c: §fControls the chance for a glyph to be lost during one refresh.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.signal_loss_s: §fControls how quickly signal-loss states are randomized again.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.note_bounce.t: §fApplies rhythmic note-like bounces based on glyph position, suited to music-themed text.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.note_bounce_a: §fControls the maximum height of note bounces.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.note_bounce_s: §fControls how quickly the note rhythm advances.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.sweep.tip: §fMoves a concentrated bright energy band from one end of the text to the other.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.sweep_speed.t: §fControls how quickly the energy band completes a sweep.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.sweep_width.t: §fControls how many glyphs the energy band covers at once.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.sweep_strengt: §fControls how strongly the sweep boosts brightness and color.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.outline.tip: §fAdds a stable edge around glyphs to improve readability on complex backgrounds.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.outline_width: §fControls how far the outline expands outside the glyph; very high values can make small text look heavy.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.outline_alpha: §fControls outline opacity; higher values produce a more solid edge.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.glow.tip: §fRenders the text body at full brightness so it stays clear in darkness, and adds a stable vanilla glow outline. Any larger soft bloom while shaders are active is controlled by the shader pack itself.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.glow_radius.t: §fControls the perceived spread and luminance weight of the glow outline; higher values make it more pronounced. To avoid flicker, the actual outline width follows the stable vanilla font outline path.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.glow_alpha.ti: §fControls the visibility of the outer glow outline; it does not reduce the brightness of the emissive text body.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.trail.tip: §fLeaves translucent copies behind moving glyphs to emphasize speed and drifting motion.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.trail_strengt: §fControls the maximum distance between the trail and the main glyph.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.trail_alpha.t: §fControls trail opacity; higher values make trails easier to see.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.extrude.tip: §fAdds darker layers diagonally behind text to create visible thickness and a 3D extrusion.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.extrude_depth: §fControls how far the extrusion extends behind the text.
cfg.textstudio.font.author.extrude_alpha: §fControls the visibility of the extrusion layers.
gui.textstudio.font.editor.palette.enabl: §fUses a custom color sequence instead of the default color source, cycling text through your selected palette.
gui.textstudio.font.editor.palette.speed: §fControls how quickly colors move through the custom palette.
gui.textstudio.font.editor.palette.sprea: §fControls palette index spacing between adjacent glyphs; higher values show a wider color spread at once.
gui.textstudio.font.editor.palette.flash: §fWhen enabled, colors jump directly to the next palette entry instead of blending smoothly.
